description: Deterministic offline scorers used to accept or reject a trial. No model-as-judge, no scoring network, no human grading in this freeze.

json_exact.decision: parsed model JSON must equal the hidden reference value exactly, after fenced-code-block stripping
json_exact.extra_constraint: max_compact_chars, when declared on the record, bounds the serialised compact form

topological_order.decision: any permutation that covers every node exactly once and respects every precedence edge is accepted; the fixture order is not privileged

python_unit.decision: model code is executed against hidden unit cases inside IsolatedCodeRunner with the network disabled; all cases must pass
python_unit.policy_flag: the presence of os/socket/subprocess in emitted code raises policy_violation when the trial also fails

determinism.python_unit: deterministic given the same interpreter and sandbox limits; a sandbox timeout is reported as sandbox_fail and counted as a failed trial, never as a missing observation

acceptance_binding.grader_version_field: EvalResult.grader_version must carry g13-scorer-v1 for every counted observation
acceptance_binding.worker_visibility: hidden reference values and unit cases are grader-side inputs and must never be routed into the model prompt; see identity_prompt_v1.json

confidence_bound.caution: wilson_lower_bound defaults to z=1.96 (one-sided 97.5 percent). Counted qualification must pass z explicitly; the default must not be relied on.

change_policy: any change to the pinned grader or sandbox modules invalidates this scorer identity: mint g13-scorer-v2 and a new pool freeze version
